description:
T27 Willow. (Future management recommendation to reduce chance of further limb breakage. Crown reduce to the previous crown reduction points removing approximately X metres. All pruning cuts shall be made to suitable secondary growth points and shall maintain a stable platform for the expected regrowth and shall not exceed beyond the previous crown reduction points.
T49 Horse Chestnut - Reduce lateral spread of crown on east side (toward river) by approximately 2.5m (Medium)
T50 Horse Chestnut - Reduce lateral spread of crown on east side by approximately 2.5m (Medium)
T53 Horse Chestnut - Remove torn branch stub on east side of stem and attached 12cm diameter branch. Reduce lateral spread of remaining crown on east side by approximately 2.5m (Medium)
T64 Holly - Very sparse in upper crown, has declined significantly since last inspection. Fell to as close to ground level as possible (Medium)
T72 Sycamore - Cut back to clear lamp column by 2m (Medium)
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
